sources.title: W3C WAI-ARIA APG — Modal Dialog Pattern
sources.titleEn: W3C WAI-ARIA APG — Modal Dialog Pattern
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: SVG viewBox：工程圖縮放與點選座標
related.titleEn: SVG viewBox: engineering diagrams and hit coordinates
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付focus-trace.csv、動態刪除測試與輔助技術版本紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver focus-trace.csv, the dynamic-removal test and assistive-technology version notes.
related.difference: 畫出圖面四角及中心，分別計算scale、水平留白與垂直留白，再標示螢幕位置。
related.differenceEn: Mark corners and center, calculate scale and letterbox offsets, then annotate viewport positions.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
模態對話框需要可辨識名稱、適當初始焦點、Tab圍限與關閉後焦點返回；aria-modal本身不實作行為。
教學基準：7-4*floor(7/4) = 3 focus_index；對照：(3-1+4)-4*floor((3-1+4)/4) = 2 focus_index。

viewBox與preserveAspectRatio共同決定縮放和平移；點選位置必須用反矩陣轉回圖面座標。
教學基準：min(600/800,600/400) = 0.75 scale_or_px；對照：(600-400*0.75)/2 = 150 scale_or_px。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
A modal dialog needs a name, suitable initial focus, Tab containment and focus restoration; aria-modal alone implements none of those behaviors.
Teaching baseline: 7-4*floor(7/4) = 3 focus_index; comparison: (3-1+4)-4*floor((3-1+4)/4) = 2 focus_index.

viewBox and preserveAspectRatio determine scale and translation; hit positions must be transformed back with the inverse matrix.
Teaching baseline: min(600/800,600/400) = 0.75 scale_or_px; comparison: (600-400*0.75)/2 = 150 scale_or_px.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Vue computed：相依追蹤與快取失效
related.titleEn: Vue computed: dependency tracking and invalidation
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付focus-trace.csv、動態刪除測試與輔助技術版本紀錄。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver focus-trace.csv, the dynamic-removal test and assistive-technology version notes.
related.difference: 建立含price、qty、tax的反應式物件，對getter加計數器以觀察實際重算。
related.differenceEn: Create reactive price, qty, tax and instrument getter calls to observe recomputation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
模態對話框需要可辨識名稱、適當初始焦點、Tab圍限與關閉後焦點返回；aria-modal本身不實作行為。
教學基準：7-4*floor(7/4) = 3 focus_index；對照：(3-1+4)-4*floor((3-1+4)/4) = 2 focus_index。

computed根據反應式相依快取；methods每次呼叫都執行，非反應式時鐘不會自動使computed失效。
教學基準：100*3*(1+0.05) = 315 currency_units；對照：100*4*(1+0.05) = 420 currency_units。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
A modal dialog needs a name, suitable initial focus, Tab containment and focus restoration; aria-modal alone implements none of those behaviors.
Teaching baseline: 7-4*floor(7/4) = 3 focus_index; comparison: (3-1+4)-4*floor((3-1+4)/4) = 2 focus_index.

Computed properties cache by reactive dependencies; methods execute on each call, and a nonreactive clock does not invalidate a computed value.
Teaching baseline: 100*3*(1+0.05) = 315 currency_units; comparison: 100*4*(1+0.05) = 420 currency_units.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
